pron_note: British: THU-ruh, second syllable swallowed. Two syllables either way — never "throo."
means:
Complete in every respect; done with attention to every part, leaving no gap.

**Thorough** praises the *process*, not the talent. A thorough investigator isn't necessarily clever — they simply went everywhere and checked everything. Set against neighbours: **meticulous** perfects each inch and can shade into fussiness; **exhaustive** stresses that nothing remains; **thorough** is the honest, workmanlike middle — full coverage, no shortcuts.

It also works as a flat intensifier before a noun, and there it usually turns nasty: *a thorough nuisance*, *a thorough scoundrel* — meaning "completely, in every respect."
trap: ⚠️ **thorough ≠ through.** One extra *o* changes everything: **through** = from end to end (preposition), **thorough** = leaving nothing out (adjective). *She went through the files* is movement; *she was thorough with the files* is quality.
trick_line: **thorough = through + an extra O** — it goes all the way through, and then some.
trick_unpack: The spare letter is the spare effort: a thorough job doesn't just pass through the material, it covers every corner of it.
sentences: The audit was **thorough** to the point of cruelty: eleven years of receipts, every one matched to a bank line.
Give the pan a **thorough** scrub — not that thirty-second rinse you did last time.
in_the_wild: A **thoroughbred** racehorse at the Derby is one bred *through and through* — pedigree verified all the way back, no gaps in the line. Same word, hiding in plain sight.
etymology:
**thorough** *is* **through** — both from Old English **þurh**, which split into a short preposition and a long adjective. That history is the definition: to be thorough is to have gone right through the thing.

The family keeps the sense literal: a **thoroughfare** is a road that runs all the way through (hence the "No Thoroughfare" sign), and **thoroughgoing** doubles down on the same idea.
one_line: Complete in every detail — nothing skipped, nothing left unchecked.
